classes.name: SiteInformationForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring site information settings such as site name, slogan, email, front page, and error pages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies like alias manager, path validator, and request context.

methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.
